summary: Translational Development Acquisition Corp. (TDAC) filed an 8-K reporting shareholder redemption results and extension vote outcome related to its proposed business combination with ProLogium Holding Inc. 85% of shares (approx. $156.8M in trust) were not redeemed, and 95% of votes favored extension. The merger, announced May 27, 2026, targets ProLogium, a lithium ceramic battery firm serving AI data centers, aerospace, robotics, defense, and EVs. No per-share price or premium stated; no advisors named. The filing combines Rule 425 and Rule 14a-12 communications. Watch for definitive proxy/prospectus and shareholder vote on the business combination; risk-arb centers on regulatory clearance and trust preservation.
